name: Batra Cart and Catalog Discounts for WooCommerce
author: batragroup

sections.description:
Batra Cart and Catalog Discounts for WooCommerce is a straightforward promotions screen: set the discount, choose who it applies to, and pick the dates.

  • Quantity discounts when the cart reaches a minimum number of items.
  • Category discounts, including one rule for every category.
  • Product discounts that also cover all variations of a variable product.
  • A start and end date for the whole promotion, plus an optional end date on each rule.

Category and product discounts show the regular price crossed out next to the new price. Quantity discounts are applied in the cart and are not added on top of those prices. Products that already have a WooCommerce sale price are left unchanged.

This is a third-party extension by Batra (https://batra.by). It is not developed by, or affiliated with, WooCommerce or Automattic.

No external service is used. The plugin does not send store or customer data to third parties.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the batra-cart-catalog-discounts-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate WooCommerce if it is not already active.
  3. Activate Batra Cart and Catalog Discounts for WooCommerce.
  4. Open WooCommerce > Batra Discounts.
  5. Configure the global schedule and the discount rules you need.
  6. Save the settings and test the cart and checkout flow before using the rules in production.
sections.faq:
Does it support variable products?

Yes. A product-specific rule saved for a variable product applies to its variations. Category rules also account for the parent product categories.

What happens when a product already has a native WooCommerce sale price?

The plugin leaves that native sale price unchanged. It does not apply its category or product price rule on top of the native sale price.

Can category and product rules overlap?

Yes. When both apply, the larger percentage is used.

How are quantity discounts applied?

The plugin totals eligible cart quantities, selects the largest matching quantity-discount rule, and adds the discount as a negative WooCommerce fee.

Does the plugin use an external service or collect data?

No. It works locally in WordPress and WooCommerce and does not send store or customer data to an external service.

I already used the earlier private build. Can both copies stay active?

No. On activation this plugin turns off the older private folder woocommerce-easy-discount and the previous easy-discount-for-woocommerce folder if they are still active, then copies their saved rules into its own settings. Running both copies at once would apply the same discount twice.

What happens to settings when the plugin is deleted?

Deleting the plugin from the Plugins screen removes its own settings. Settings saved by the earlier private build are left in place. Deactivating the plugin keeps its settings.

1.0.2

  • Deleting the plugin no longer removes settings saved by the earlier private build.

1.0.1

  • Renamed the plugin to Batra Cart and Catalog Discounts for WooCommerce.
  • Activation no longer stops when an older copy of the plugin is still active.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Quantity, category, and individual product discount rules.
  • Global promotion schedule and per-rule end dates.
  • Variable product support.
  • Native WooCommerce sale-price protection.
  • Import of settings saved by the earlier private build.
